applicant_utility.summary: This is the Type A (Embassy-recommended) route into the Chinese Government Scholarship for Bangladeshi nationals, and the Embassy's own announcement spells out the whole package: full tuition, on-campus accommodation, medical insurance, a monthly allowance of roughly CNY 2,500-3,500 depending on programme level, and international round-trip airfare. Applications run entirely through the CSC portal at campuschina.org - the Embassy takes no papers. The 2025/2026 deadline was 10 January 2026, so for the next round watch the Embassy's pages from around mid-December.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Bangladeshi students seeking a fully funded degree or language year in China who can prepare a complete CSC online file unaided.
application_readiness_checklist: Diarise the Embassy's announcement cycle - last year's notice appeared on 19 December with a 10 January deadline
Open the campuschina.org account early and complete it as a Type A applicant routed through Bangladesh
Prepare the standard CSC file: notarised diploma and transcripts, passport, study plan, recommendation letters, physical examination form and police clearance
Choose your programme level deliberately - the monthly allowance steps up with the degree level
Keep every uploaded scan clean and legible, since the portal file is the whole application
common_rejection_risks: Treating the Embassy announcement as the application - no file exists until it is in the CSC system
Missing the Embassy's short window (the last cycle was barely three weeks)
Incomplete uploads: the Embassy warns applicants to submit all required documents within the stipulated time
Budgeting against the headline allowance range without checking which level applies to your programme
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Visa fees, notarisation and translation costs, and personal spending beyond the monthly allowance.
document_audit: Everything must go through the CSC portal - there is no Embassy drop-off or paper route
The monthly allowance varies by programme level, so budget against your own level rather than the headline range
alerts: Type A means the Embassy recommends and the China Scholarship Council decides - selection is competitive and documented through the portal
The 2026 deadline has passed and no new date is published yet, so do not rely on last year's timetable
Chinese Government Scholarship holders cannot simultaneously hold other Chinese government awards
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single online file at campuschina.org before the Embassy deadline; the Embassy then coordinates with the China Scholarship Council on recommendations.
